units.source_text: 门前流过一条小河，是具有浓厚京都色彩的小河。

en.t: A small stream flowed past the front gate, a stream rich with the atmosphere of Kyoto.

units.source_text: 岸边的水草也以固有的姿势向水面倾斜。

en.t: The water plants along the bank also leaned toward the surface in their own natural posture.

units.source_text: 岸上的白墙，可能就是大友的家。

en.t: The white wall on the bank was probably Otomo's house.
